meta.title: onespec — The window & door configurator for your website
meta.description: onespec is the window and door configurator widget you embed via iframe: automatic quotes, always up-to-date pricing, brandable for your company.

hero.title: The window & door configurator that qualifies your leads for you
hero.subtitle: A widget you embed on your site with an iFrame code. Automatic quotes, an always-current price list, your brand.

configurator.title: This is the configurator. Try it now.
configurator.subtitle: This isn't a screenshot: it's the exact widget your customers get, loaded here inside an iFrame. Change material, sizes and finishes and watch the quote update.

valueProp.title: Every day you lose time on requests that go nowhere
valueProp.body: Curiosity calls, pointless site visits, competitors posing as customers just to undercut you on price. onespec puts a configurator between you and these requests: whoever reaches you has already figured out the product and the budget.

features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't

items.title: One iFrame, and you're live
items.description: You paste a code on your site and the configurator appears, already working. No development, no technical maintenance.

items.title: 100% brandable
items.description: Colors, fonts and logo of your configurator match your brand. Your customer won't even know onespec exists.

items.title: Price list from a file, always current
items.description: You upload your price list, the configurator decodes it. Update the file, the widget updates everywhere it's installed.

items.title: Filters out anyone who isn't a real buyer
items.description: No more wasting time on people who only want to compare prices to undercut you. The configurator qualifies the request before it reaches you.

items.title: Prices close to reality
items.description: Configurable pricing rules for materials, sizes and finishes: the quote the customer sees is almost the final one.

items.title: Instant updates
items.description: You update the configurator from the onespec platform: changes go live on every site where it's installed, immediately.

dashboard.title: Quotes come in, you see them in real time
dashboard.subtitle: Every request the configurator generates lands straight in the dashboard: how many come in, from which products, and how the average value grows month after month.

steps.title: From price list to a live quote in four steps

items.title: Upload your price list
items.description: A file with products, sizes, materials and prices. onespec reads it and turns it into a configurator.

items.title: Brand the widget
items.description: Colors, logo, copy and pricing rules from the platform. No code required.

items.title: Paste the iFrame code
items.description: The configurator appears on your site, responsive on desktop and mobile, ready to collect requests.

items.title: Receive qualified quotes
items.description: Every request arrives already with sizes, materials and the customer's indicative budget.

pricing.title: You pay based on how hard the configurator works for you
pricing.subtitle: Three plans, based on monthly quote requests and branding. With Alpha access, {percent}% off Starter and Business.

cta.title: Be among the first to bring onespec to your site
cta.subtitle: Alpha stage, {seats} spots. Whoever joins now helps shape the product and locks in the launch price.

iframeExplainer.title: What's an iFrame code?
iframeExplainer.subtitle: It's the technical part of onespec, and it's the only one. No developer needed, nothing on your existing site gets touched.

points.title: It's a window inside your site
points.body: The iFrame shows an external page inside one of your pages. Visitors see the configurator as if it were part of your site: no page change, no leaving you.

points.title: You paste it once
points.body: Copy the code and paste it wherever you want the configurator to appear. Works with WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow or a hand-built site: it's standard HTML.

points.title: It updates itself
points.body: The content lives on our servers. When you change the price list or colors from the platform, the code on your site stays identical and the configurator is already updated.

iframeExplainer.footnote: Only one line changes from customer to customer: <id>tuo-id</id>. Everything else is identical for everyone.

hero.title: A widget, not a software project
hero.subtitle: onespec was born from a direct request by window and door manufacturers and dealers: an interactive configurator that saves time, filters out serious requests and protects your prices from unfair competition.

configurator.title: Try it the way your customer does
configurator.subtitle: The widget below is loaded in an iFrame, exactly as it would appear on your site. Configure a window and watch the quote calculate in real time.

blocks.title: 1. Upload the price list
blocks.description: You provide your price list files: products, available sizes, materials, finishes and prices. onespec decodes them and automatically builds the configurator's logic, with nothing to re-enter by hand.

blocks.title: 2. Brand the widget
blocks.description: Choose colors, fonts, logo and copy for the configurator from the platform. The result is a widget that looks built specifically for your site, not an external plugin.

blocks.title: 3. Paste the iFrame code
blocks.description: A single snippet to paste on your site's page. The configurator is responsive by default: designed for mobile and desktop, not just adapted.

blocks.title: 4. Always update from the platform
blocks.description: Change prices, add products or edit discount rules from the onespec dashboard. Changes go live on every site where the widget is installed, without touching the client's code.

dashboard.title: The dashboard that controls it all
dashboard.subtitle: Requests received, most configured products, average quote value. From here you update price lists and rules, and changes go live wherever the widget is installed.

midCta.title: Less time on curious visitors, more time on ready buyers
midCta.subtitle: The configurator collects sizes, materials and budget before you even pick up the phone. Whoever contacts you after configuring has already decided to buy.

support.title: Support included in every plan
support.subtitle: The level of support grows with the plan you choose.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page describes how onespec ("we") collects, uses and protects the personal data of anyone visiting the site or using the platform, in compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).

sections.heading: Data controller
sections.body: The data controller is onespec. For any request regarding personal data you can write to {email}.

sections.heading: Data collected
list: Contact details voluntarily provided (name, email, company) via forms or email.
Technical browsing data (IP address, browser type, pages visited) collected in aggregate form.
Data related to quote requests generated through the configurator, where applicable.

sections.heading: Purpose of processing
list: Responding to requests for information, Alpha access or partnerships.
Managing service delivery for customers subscribed to the platform.
Improving the site and platform through aggregate statistical analysis.

sections.heading: Legal basis
sections.body: Processing is based on the data subject's consent, on the performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures, and on the legitimate interest in maintaining and improving the service.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: Data is retained for the time necessary to achieve the stated purposes, and in any case no longer than required by applicable law.

sections.heading: Data subject rights
sections.body: You can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing or portability of your data at any time by writing to {email}.

termini.title: Terms of Service
termini.intro: Using the onespec site and platform implies acceptance of these terms. onespec is currently in Alpha stage: some features may change or be discontinued during development.

sections.heading: Service description
sections.body: onespec provides a window and door configurator widget embeddable via iFrame code, manageable and updatable from the onespec platform. The service is offered by subscription based on the chosen plan.

sections.heading: Account and customer responsibility
list: The customer is responsible for the accuracy of data and price lists uploaded to the platform.
The customer is responsible for the correctness of quotes generated based on the data provided.
Access to the platform is personal and may not be transferred to third parties without authorization.

sections.heading: Subscriptions and billing
sections.body: Subscriptions renew automatically according to the chosen billing period, unless cancelled before renewal. Usage limits (monthly quote requests, number of configurators) are defined by the active plan.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: onespec provides the configuration tool but is not responsible for commercial agreements, final quotes or sales concluded between the customer and their end users.

sections.heading: Changes to the terms
sections.body: During the Alpha stage these terms may be updated more frequently. Material changes will be communicated to active customers.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For questions about the terms of service write to {email}.

cookie.title: Cookie Policy
cookie.intro: This site uses a minimal number of cookies and similar technologies, necessary for basic operation and, where enabled, for anonymous traffic measurement.

sections.heading: Technical cookies
sections.body: Necessary for the site to work correctly (e.g. navigation preferences). They do not require prior consent.

sections.heading: Statistical cookies
sections.body: If enabled, they collect aggregate and anonymous data on site usage to improve its content. You can decline them with no impact on browsing.

sections.heading: Managing preferences
sections.body: You can change or withdraw consent to non-technical cookies at any time through your browser settings.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For questions about the cookie policy write to {email}.
